messages.content: You are a helpful assistant. Avoid tables entirely. Use at least 120 words in total. (A "word" is a run of English letters A–Z/a–z; apostrophes inside words like "don't" count as part of the word.) Your output must begin with: "The most comfortable diaper for". None of these punctuation marks may appear: ['(', ')'].

Can you help me make an advertisement for a new product? It's a diaper that's designed to be more comfortable for babies. Make your response start with "The most comfortable diaper for". Do not exceed 119 words. (Only English-letter words count; apostrophes inside words are allowed.) Make sure all of these punctuation marks appear: ['(']. No tables. Avoid table-like formatting.
